problems: OVERLAP with Cliopatria rows owned by other groups (the new dossiers will draw the same land twice until those rows are cut): the Dutch Republic row (1582-1795) draws Indonesian, Sri Lankan and Taiwanese cells that dutch-east-india-company and dutch-malacca now carry (eu-09); the Portuguese Colonies (1640-1910) and Estado Novo (1926-1975) rows draw East Timor, which portuguese-timor keeps (sa-06, eu-21); the British Colonial Empire row draws the FMS states, the Straits Settlements and Labuan (eu-11); the United States row and the united-states-of-america dossier draw the Philippines 1898-1946, as does insular-government-of-the-philippine-islands; the Cliopatria Sultanate of Sambaliung outline (51 cells, 1830) covers all of the Berau coast and so the land of sultanate-of-gunung-tabur; Cliopatria's Banten shapes keep Bengkulu to 1808 although it was British (british-bencoolen); Cliopatria's Kedah row (Kedah proper, and Setul as the Kedah dossier reads it) includes the land of kubang-pasu (1839-1859) and setul-mambang-segara.

COUNTERPART STRINGS to change in other dossiers: sultan-of-yogyakarta and surakarta-sunanate name dutch-republic for the 1755-1799 suzerain (should be dutch-east-india-company); dutch-east-indies 1 March 1825 gain from Bencoolen names british-colonial-empire (should be british-bencoolen); sultanate-of-kedah 1786 and 1800 losses name british-colonial-empire (should be prince-of-wales-island), its 1808/1892/1909 Setul events treat Setul as land (the Setul page keeps a kingdom to 1916; setul-mambang-segara records vassal events with Kedah as counterpart) and it has no events for kubang-pasu (1839 loss, 1859 gain); straits-settlements (kept) 1907 Labuan gain names british-colonial-empire (should be colony-of-labuan); the Sambaliung dossier's note that Gunung Tabur needs a dossier is now met.

VASSAL CONVENTION: the suzerain's ledger names the vassal as counterpart (schema); the VOC, Berau, Setul and Kubang Pasu dossiers follow it, and for dependencies of the Dutch the mirror events (vassal side) are in the sibling dossiers, which should be checked for matching dates.

DATE CONFLICTS between dossiers: dutch-new-guinea opens its contest with Indonesia on 21 May 1962 (Teminabuan, Operation Trikora page) and the Indonesian dossier on 24 June 1962 (Merauke); united-states-of-america and empire-of-japan date the Japanese occupation of the Philippines as one event in May 1942, insular-government-of-the-philippine-islands has Manila on 2 January 1942 and the rest in May 1942; the Commonwealth page dates the Tydings-McDuffie Act both 24 March 1934 and 15 November 1935.

GRID LIMIT: the res-5 land grid drops tiny islands, so the Banda Islands (dutch-east-india-company, 1609-1621 conquest) resolve to 0 cells within 80 km (4 resolve warnings accepted); the dossier carries the disc and the event text.

PAGE BUDGET: dutch-east-india-company used 7 pages (budget 2-5) because it is the largest missing state of the group; every other new dossier used 1-3 pages (several are thin: sultanate-of-gunung-tabur, kubang-pasu and setul-mambang-segara have one or two pages each and no boundary).

PAGES: the English titles tried for Berau, Gunung Tabur, Kasepuhan, Kanoman and the Presidency of Prince of Wales Island returned url_not_found (the articles may exist under other titles); id.wikipedia was used for Berau and Gunung Tabur; 'Bencoolen' redirects to the province article Bengkulu and 'Kubang Pasu' is a disambiguation page (the Kingdom of Kubang Pasu Darul Qiyam title was used).

SCRATCH DRAFTS from an earlier cut-short run (2026-10-20, /tmp/claude-0/work/research-se-03-x/out) for the French protectorates, Malayan Union, Colony of Singapore, Crown Colony of Sarawak, Second Philippine Republic, State of Burma, Empire of Vietnam and Kingdom of Kampuchea were not published or reused, since their pages were not re-opened in this run; the french-indochina dossier already carries the French components.
UNRESOLVED COUNTERPARTS: malayan-union is named by federated-malay-states and straits-settlements (2 resolve warnings) and needs a dossier (se-04).

The four dossiers kept from an earlier run (spanish-east-indies, straits-settlements, british-burma, british-north-borneo) were validated and left unchanged; british-burma has 3 resolve warnings for the unknown place Kengtung and straits-settlements 1 for malayan-union.
